goal: Produce a truthful v0.2.69 release baseline whose documentation, package identity, CI, public artifacts, and adopter acceptance are consistent and auditable.
intent: Publish v0.2.69 from the reviewed synchronized default branch after correcting the v0.2.68 failed-release documentation projection, and bind immutable public-artifact acceptance.
outOfScope: and reuse of the failed v0.2.68 tag.
